text: The About screen shows the name in cuneiform: IM.DUB, read ṭuppu

Scope addition (maintainer, 2026-09-19): the same cuneiform also goes on both login screens, under the mark and the title, at a smaller size than on About and without the transliteration caption there. Same asset, same tint rule.

Landed in c72db6b: IM.DUB from Noto Sans Cuneiform outlines as web/public/tuppu-cuneiform.svg (drawn as a CSS mask over currentColor via a shared CuneiformName component) and drawable/ic_cuneiform_tuppu.xml (tinted onSurface); 64 tall under the About heading with the italic caption "ṭuppu" (U+1E6D, one string pair identical in all locales), 40 tall under the login title without it. Both accessible-labelled with the transliteration. Four new tests, mutation-checked. Gate green.
